verbetes.glosa_atual: [para recuperar força, cmp. חָלַם,] dormir, trnsf. ser ocioso, preguiçoso.
definicoes_originais: [ to recover strength, cmp. חָלַם,] to sleep, trnsf. to be idle, lazy.
notas_originais: Shebu. III, 5 (I swear) שאִישַׁן that I will sleep, שיָשַׁנְתִּי that I have slept. Num. R. s. 20 בא לִישָׁן going to sleep.—Cant. R. to III, 1 ישנתי לי מן התירה וכ' I (Israel) have been lazy in the study of the Law and the performance of good deeds; a. fr.

Midr. Till. to Ps. LIX הקב"ה עושה עצמו כביכול י' the Lord sometimes pretends, if it were permitted to say so, to be asleep; a. fr.— Pl. יְשֵׁנִים, יְשֵׁנִין, יְשֵי'. Num. R. s. 20 הרי הן י' מן וכ' they are sluggish in study &c., v. preced. Cant. R. to VII, 10 י' במערת וכ' sleeping in the cave of Makhpelah. Ex. R. s. 1; a. fr.—Fem. יְשֵׁנָה, יְשֵׁי'. Midr. Till. to Ps. CX, beg. (ref. to Is. XLI, 2) הצדקה היתה י' וכ' Righteousness was asleep and Abraham waked her up. Cant. R. to V, 2 אני י' מן וכ' I (Israel) was lazy &c., v. supra; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: cmp. precedeu. wds. um. אֵיתָן) ser forte, duro, velho (cmp. קשיש).; deixar envelhecer (forte), manter, reservar.; para ser armazenado, para melhorar com a idade.
definicoes_originais: cmp. preced. wds. a. אֵיתָן) to be strong, hard, old (cmp. קשיש).
to let grow old ( strong), keep, reserve.
to be stored up, to improve with age.
notas_originais: —V. יוֹשֶׁן a. next w.

B. Bath. 91 b דברים שדרכן ליַישְּׁנָן things which it is customary to keep (to store, as wine &c.). Deut. R. s. 9, beg. מן היין הזה אני מְיַישֵּׁן וכ' of this wine I will store away a portion for my son’s wedding. Tosef. Ab. Zar. VIII (IX), 3 צריך ליַשֵּׁן he must store them away (leave them unused); Tosef. Toh. XI, 16. Ib. כמה הוא מְיַשְּׁנָן, v. יִשּׁוּן; Y. Ab. Zar. V, end 45 b מְיַישְּׁנָן כל י"ב וכ' he must leave them unused for the whole twelve-month; Bab. ib. 75 a.—Part. pass. מְיוּשָּׁן stored up, v. infra. Y. B. Bath. VII, end, 15 c. Y. Gitt. III, end, 45 b ‘old’ means last year’s crop, מי' של וכ' ‘stored’ means three years old.

Sifra B’huck. ch. III; Yalk. Lev. 672 (ref. to ישן נושן, Lev. XXVI, 10) כל המִתְיַשֵּׁן יפה מחבירו the sort which is stored up is the better of its kind; B. Bath. l. c. [read with Ms. R.:] כל המְיוּשָּׁן יפה מחבירו. Y. Gitt. l. c. הדא אמרה דאי מתישן וכ' this intimates that if wine is sold as mithyashshen (fit for storage) the seller is responsible for three years. Sifra l. c. לרבות כל המִתְיַישְּׁנִים including all produces fit for storage (besides wine); Yalk. l. c. לרבות כל הדבר המיושן.
same. B. Bath. l. c.; a e., v. next w.

verbetes.glosa_atual: precedido.) duro, seco; antigo, do ano passado, opp. חָדָשׁ.
definicoes_originais: preced.) hard, dry; old, of last year, opp. חָדָשׁ.
notas_originais: Dem. IV, 7. B. Bath. 91 b, a. e. expl. י' נוֹשָׁן (Lev. XXVI, 10), v. preced. Ab. IV, 20 קנקן חדש מלא י' a new vessel full of old wine (a young man but learned). Ab. Zar. III, 9 ואם י' וכ' and if the oven is old (dried) &c.; a. fr.— Pl. יְשָׁנִים. Ib. 33 a י' ומזופפין old or pitched wine vessels. Yoma II, 4, v. חָדָשׁ. Lev. R. s. 2, v. חָדָשׁ; a. fr.— Fem. יְשָׁנָה. Kidd. IV, 5, Num. R. s. 9, v. אַרְכִי I.— Pl. יְשָׁנוֹת. Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV (V), 10 י' זפופות, v. supra; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: cmp. precedeu. wds.) [ ser forte, se recuperar.; assistir, ajudar, entregar.; para ser salvo, liberado.
definicoes_originais: cmp. preced. wds.) [ to be strong, to recover.
notas_originais: Sot. 34 b (ref. to י̇ה̇וש̇ע̇, Num. XIII, 17) י֗ה֗ יוֹשִׁ֗יעֲ֗ךָ וכ' Yah save thee from &c. Meg. 14 a עתידה … שיושִׁיעַ וכ' my mother shall bear a son who will deliver Israel; Sot. 11 b שמוֹשִׁיעַ. Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 4 כשתּוֹשִׁיעֵנִי מאויבי when thou shalt have saved me from my enemies. Snh. 73 a, v. מוֹשִׁיעַ. Ber. IV, 4 הוֹשַׁע וכ' help, O Lord &c.; a. fr.—V. הוֹשַׁעְנָא.

Midr. Till. l. c. אִוָּשֵׁעַ מן וכ' let me be delivered from my enemies, and I shall call the Lord the praised One. Tanḥ. Aḥǎré 12 (ref. to ויושע, Ex. XIV, 30) וַיִוָּשַׁע כתיב כביכול הוא נ' it may be read vayivvasha (and he was saved), He, as if it were, was delivered. Ib. בעוה"ז הייתם נוֹשָׁעִים ע"י ב"א in this world (the past) you were delivered through human agencies.
אוֹשֵׁיף to blow, kindle. Sabb. 119 a מוֹשִׁיף נורא fanning the fire.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) Jaspis, a joia de Benjamim no peitoral do sumo sacerdote.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) Jaspis, Benjamin’s jewel in the highpriest’s breast-plate.
notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 38, end. Y. Kidd. I, 61 b top.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ser firme, forte, saudável; ser hetero né.; י' כ' ששברת, seja agradecido por ter quebrado (as tábuas).; י' חילכם; um. e.—(יֵשַׁר) יִישַׁר (sub. כחך) obrigado! certo!; endireitar, direcionar, firmar.
definicoes_originais: to be firm, strong, healthy; to be straight, right.
י' כ' ששברת, be thanked for having broken (the tablets).
י' חילכם; a. e.—(יֵשַׁר) יִישַׁר (sub. כחך) thanks! right!
to straighten, direct, to make firm.
notas_originais: יִישַׁר כֹּחֲךָ or חֵילְךָ ‘may thy strength (health) be firm’, a phrase of approval and thanks. Sabb. 87 a, a. fr. (play on אֲשֶׁר, Ex. XXXIV,
Gen. R. s. 54 (play on וישרנה, I Sam. VI, 1
Ber. 42 b; Sabb. 53 a; Erub. 32 b; a. fr.—Cmp. אַיְשַׁר.

Ex. R. s. 1 (ref. to יֵשֶׁר, I Chr. II, 18) זה כלב שיי' את עצמו that is Caleb who kept himself straight (did not yield to the rest of the spies). Num. R. s. 8 (ref. to Ps. L, 23 ושם דרך) המְיַישֵּׁר אורחותיו וכ' he who directs his ways straight (pays regard to his doings).—Part. pass. מְיוּשָּׁר, f. מְיוּשֶּׁרֶת. Pirké d’R. El. ch. X דרכי מי' לפני my way is levelled before me.—Meg. 18 b (ref. to יישרו, Prov. IV, 25) מְיוּשָּׁרִין הן אצל וכ' they remain firm with (in the memory of) &c.
Targ. II Esth. VII, 9 יִישַׁר חילך (Var. יִשַּׁר). [Cant. R. to I, 4 ישריין, v. next w.]
Targ. Y. Deut. X, 2, v. אֲשַׁר.

verbetes.glosa_atual: precedido.) firme, sólido; reto, certo, vertical.
definicoes_originais: preced.) firm, sound; straight, right, upright.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 49 אברהם זה י' מן היְשָׁרִים this Abraham is firmer than all the firm (angels); Yalk. ib. 82 אברהם זה י'; Midr. Till. to Ps. XI, 7 קודם לִישָׁרוֹ של עולם וכ' before they see the Right One of the world, they (the pious) shall behold the faces of the firm (believers); a. fr.— Pl. יְשָׁרִים, יְשָׁרִין. Cant. R. to I, 4 מה ישריין רחמיך, [read as:] Yalk. ib. 982 מה ישרים וכ', expl. מה תקיפין וכ' how strong are thy mercies. Midr. Till. l. c. איזו כת … זו כת י' which is the highest class among those who will greet the countenance of the Divine Presence (in the hereafter)? The class of the firm believers. Ib. to Ps. XXV, 14 … בתחלה ואה"כ נתן לי' first the secret of the Lord is communicated to those who fear him (human beings), and then to the firm ones (the angels, cmp. יְצוּקִים s. v. יָצַק); Gen. R. s. 49; a. e.— Fem. יְשָׁרָה, pl. יְשָׁרוֹת (sub בעיניו; with ref. to Deut. XII, 8) [ right in the eyes of the offerer,] free-will offerings (opp. חוֹבָה). Zeb. 114 a י' תקריבו וכ' free-will sacrifices you may offer (on the bamoth, v. בָּמָה), but no obligatory offerings; ib. 117 b. Ib. י' נינהו they belong to the class of free-will offerings. Ib. 118 a; a. fr.—סֵפֶר הַיָּשָׁר the Book Yashar, a lost book (Josh. X, 13; II Sam. I, 18). Ab. Zar. 25 a. Y. Sot. I, end, 17 c
Y. Taan. II, 65 b (ref. to Mic. VII, 4) י' דבהון וכ' the upright man among them is like thorns.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Israel.; I. (Jacó), o patriarca. General R. s. 68 י' סבא o patriarca I.; Eu., o povo. Ber. 6a; um. fr.—שונאי י' os inimigos de Israel, muitas vezes eufemismo. para Israel.; י' (= בן י') um israelita, a) alguém que não pertence à tribo sacerdotal ou levítica; b) um judeu, op. Sim, sim.
definicoes_originais: I. (Jacob), the patriarch. Gen. R. s. 68 י' סבא the patriarch I.
I., the people. Ber. 6 a; a. fr.—שונאי י' the enemies of Israel, often euphem. for Israel.
י' (= בן י') an Israelite, a) one not belonging to the priestly or levitic tribe; b) a Jew, opp. נכרי, גוי.
notas_originais: the patriarch I. (not the people); a. fr.
Ib. 32 a נתמוטטו … של ש' י' the feet of Israel would totter (in judgment); a. fr.—V. כְּנֶסֶת.

Gitt. V, 8. Tosef. Kidd. V, 3; a. fr.—Tosef. Ab. Zar. III, 5, sq. Ab. Zar. II, 6; a. fr.—בַּת י' an Israelitish woman. Tosef. l. c. 1; 3; a. fr.— Pl. יִשְׂרְאֵלוֹת (opp. to כַּהֲנוֹת, לְוִיּוֹת). Tosef. Snh. IV, 2.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) alguém pertencente a uma família israelita comum, contrad. para כֹּהֲנִי, a. לְוִיִי.
definicoes_originais: (preced.) one belonging to a common Israelitish family, contrad. to כֹּהֲנִי, a. לְוִיִי.
notas_originais: Kidd. IV, 1; Yeb. 37 a (collective noun).— Pl. יִשְׂרְאֵלִים. Ib. 85 a. Tosef. Ber. V, 14.— Fem. יִשְׂרְאֵלִית an Israelitish ( Jewish) woman. Nidd. IV, 2 (33 b) (collective noun, opp. to כותיות).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. יוֹשֶׁר a. יָשָׁר) firmeza, fé, conduta correta, equidade.
definicoes_originais: (v. יוֹשֶׁר a. יָשָׁר) firmness, faith, right conduct, equity.
notas_originais: Y. Meg. I, 72 c top (ref. to Deut. XII, 8, cmp. יָשָׁר) ומה תעשו שם דבר שהוא בא לידי י' וכ' and what dare you do there (on the bamah)? An act by which one is led towards faith, which is burnt-offerings and peace-offerings. Midr. Till. to Ps. XCIX, 4 (ref. to מישרים ib.) אתה כוננת י' של עולם (ed. Bub. י' בעולמך) thou hast established the firmness of thy world (through courts of justice); Yalk. Ps. 852 י' בעולמך.—Gen. R. s. 54 (ref. to וישרנה, I Sam. VI, 12) מהלכות בי' they walked with propriety (paying reverence to the Ark; Midr. Sam. ch. XII ביופי). Ruth R. introd. 3 (ref. to ישר, Prov. XXI, 8) במדת י' in fairness; ib. בי'; Yalk. Prov. 959. Deut. R. s. 8 היא וכל כלי אומנתה ניתנה … יַשְׁרוּתָה she (the Torah) and all her implements have been given to man, her humility, her righteousness and her fairness.—Sot. 9 b, v. next w.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedido.) aquilo que parece certo, vontade arbitrária.
definicoes_originais: (v. preced.) that which seems right, arbitrary will.
notas_originais: Sot. 9 b (ref. to Jud. XIV, 3 ישרה בעיני) כי אזל מיהא בתר יַשְׁרוּתֵיה אזל when he (Samson) went out (to marry), he, at all events, followed only his own liking (not the will of the Lord); [marginal version יַשְׁרוּת עיניו]; Yalk. Jud. 69.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. אִית) [ ser, existência,] uma partícula; indicando o caso objetivo (= h. אֵת).; (com sufixo pronominal da terceira pessoa) ele mesmo, este etc. Y. Bic. III, 65 d top אמר יָתֵיה דמן רבנן disse que ele (que foi mencionado anteriormente como) um dos estudiosos. General R. s. 9, imploro.; Koh. R. a III, 11, a. e. יַתְהוֹן aqueles (opp. para דין), v.
definicoes_originais: indicating the objective case (= h. אֵת).

(with pronominal suffix of the third person) he himself, this one &c. Y. Bicc. III, 65 d top אמר יָתֵיה דמן רבנן said he (who was before mentioned as) one of the scholars. Gen. R. s. 9, beg.; Koh. R. to III, 11, a. e. יַתְהוֹן those (opp. to דין), v. הֲנִי.
notas_originais: Targ. Gen. I, 1; a. v. fr.—With pronominal suffixes: יָתִי me, יָתָךְ, יָתִיךְ thee &c. Targ. Deut. IV, 14. Targ. Gen. XII, 12. Ib. L, 21; a. v. fr.
—With prepositional prefix: וַת, v. כְּוָת, לְוָת.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , sentar, habitar etc.; ser habitado, resolvido.; colocar, colocar.; para resolver, estabelecer.; aquietar, descansar.
definicoes_originais: , to sit, dwell &c.; to be inhabited, settled.
to place, seat, settle (v. יָשַׁב Hif.).
to be allowed to dwell, to sojourn (h. גּוּר).
to be set at ease, be gratified.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Gen. XXXVI, 7 מִיתַּב ed. Berl. (oth. ed. a. Y. מֵיתַב). Targ. O. Ex. XVI, 35 יָתֵיבְתָּא (Y. מֵיתִיבָא) inhabited; a. v. fr.—Imper. תִּיב, תִּיבִי. Targ. Gen. XX, 15. Targ. Is. LII, 2 (ed. Wil. תְּבִי); a. fr.—Yeb. 109 a יָתְבָא תותיה she lives under (with) him. Ber. 6 a עד דיַתְבֵי when they are seated. Ib. 48 a ורחמנא היכא י' and where does the Lord reside?—M. Kat. 9 b ליחרוב ביתך ולֵיתוּב אושפיזך may thy house (grave) be vacant, and thy inn (temporary home on earth) be inhabited; Tanḥ. B’resh. 13; a fr.—י' … וקאמר N. N. sat down (lecturing) and said &c. Bets. 20 a; a. fr.
Y. Kil. IX, 32 c top; Y. Keth. XII, 35 b top י' ליה ולא וכ' he set him down (let his coffin down) and would not take him back again (v. תּוּב); a. e.
Targ. Is. XLIII, 20 אֲיַתֵּיב (ed. Wil. אַיְתֵב Af.).—Targ. Ps. XXII, 4; a. e.

Targ. Ps. XXIII, 3 יְיַתִּיב (ed. Wil. יְתִיב, v. תּוּב).—Ber. 28 a ליַתּוּבֵי דעתיה to set his mind at ease. Yoma 81 a יַתּוּבֵי דעתא making one come to. B. Bath. 3 b ליַתּוּבֵיה ליצריה in order to gratify his passion. Lev. R. s. 19 [read:] תִּתְיַתַּב ליך נפשיך היך כמה דיַתְּבַת לנפשי may thy soul be restored to thee as thou hast restored my soul; a. e.— Part. pass. מְיַתַּב, מְיַתְּבָא, מְיַתְבָא a) inhabited. Targ. Ps. CVII, 4.—b) quieted. Tam. 32 a נחותי ימא לא מְיַ' דעתיהון וכ' (or מִיַּתְּבָא, v. infra) sea-farers do not feel at ease until they reach land.

Targ. I Kings XXI, 9. Targ. Gen. XLVII, 6; a. fr.—Y. Kidd. I, 58 d אַיְיתִיבוּנִי על גיף וכ' bury, me at the bank of the river; Y. Keth. VI, end, 31 a אייתבון (corr. acc.). Ḥull. 59 a נֵיתְבֵיה בתנורא … אוֹתְבֵיה let it be put in the oven; … he put it in. Yoma 69 b אוֹתִיבוּ בתעניתא וכ' they made (people) sit fasting, they ordered a fast of three days &c.; a. fr. [אוֹתִיב for אָתֵיב, v. תּוּב.]
אִיתּוֹתַב
Targ. O. Gen. XX, 1 (Y. אתנתב, corr. acc.). Targ. Jer. XLIX, 33; a. fr.—Sabb. 33 b אִיתְּבוּ תריסר וכ' they dwelt in the cave twelve years.
. Targ. Is. XLIV, 26. Targ. Jer. L, 13; a. fr.

Targ. Is. LXII, 5.—B. Mets. 83 b bot. לא מִיַּיתְּבָא דעתיה he was not satisfied. Yoma 80 b; מי' דעתיה he will come to again.—Sabb. 51 b, sq. כי היכי דתִיתּוֹתַב דעתיה Ms. O. (Ms. M. דתייב, ed. דאיתותב, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) that he may be reconciled. Lev. R. s. 19, v. supra; a. fr. [אִתּוֹתַב for אִתָּתַב, v. תּוּב.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. precedido.; cmp. יהב dar e colocar) dar (não usado no tempo perf.).
definicoes_originais: (v. preced.; cmp. יהב to give and to place) to give (not used in perf. tense).
notas_originais: Sabb. 19 a במשחא נִיתֵּיב ליה וכ' (Ms. M. נמשח ונ') let him measure when giving (the goods to wash) and when receiving it back. Kidd. 78 b אי בעי מִיתְּבָא … לא יהיב ליה (not יהבי) if he desired to give it to him as a donation, could he not do it? Keth. 106 b וליכא למיתבא ליה and he will have nothing to give him. B. Kam. 83 b; a. e.—B. Bath. 13 b למיתב Ms. M. (ed. למִיתַּן).
Targ. O. Gen. XXXIV, 30 יָתֵיב ed. Berl. (ed. יַתְבֵי pl.). Targ. O. Num. XIV, 14. Targ. Is. VI, 11; a. fr.— Pl. יָתְבַיָּא, יַתְבֵי. Targ. Y. Num. l. c.; a. fr.

definicoes_originais: , pl. יָתְבִין dwelling places, v. יִתּוּבָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: [algo preso, cravado,] estaca, prego; alça de uma ferramenta etc. Y. Taan. IV, 67 d אשרי אדם… י' להיתלות בה (cmp. Is. XXII, 23, sq.) feliz o homem que tem uma estaca para se segurar, ou seja, que tem uma ascendência renomada; ומה היתה יְתֵידָתוֹ וכ' e o que foi R. E.
definicoes_originais: [ something fastened, driven in,] peg, nail; handle of a tool &c. Y. Taan. IV, 67 d אשרי אדם … י' להיתלות בה (cmp. Is. XXII, 23, sq.) happy the man who has a peg to hang on, i.e. who has a renowned ancestry; ומה היתה יְתֵידָתוֹ וכ' and what was R. E.

Meg. 6 a והיא היתה י' תקועה וכ' and she (Cæsarea) was a peg driven into Israel, i.e. an obnoxious foreign element.—י' של מחרישה the pin of the plough. Sabb. definicoes_originais: (יְתַר) remaining over, too much, too many; extraordinary, especial.
notas_originais: Targ. O. Ex. XXVI, 12 (Y. מיתרא). Ib. דיַתִּירָא (ed. Berl. דיָתְרָא, Y. יְתֵירָא). Ib. 13.—Ḥull. 47 a חסיר או י' one lobe wanting or one too many. B. Mets. 93 b, v. טִרְחָא. Ib. 21 a מילתא י' something more than duty requires. B. Mets. 104 b מילתא י' a disproportionate amount. Gitt. 64 b ידא י' an additional hand (her own and her father’s power of accepting the letter of divorce). B. Bath. 104 b top [read:] ואי איכא יתירא and if there is a surplus, v. מַלֵּיתָא.—B. Kam. 94 a תעזוב י' the superfluous verse containing תעזב (Lev. XIX, 10, repeated ib. XXIII, 22); a. fr.—Esp. יתירתא an additional lobe of the lungs. Ḥull. 47 a.— Pl. יַתִּירִין, יַתִּירַיָּא, יַתִּירֵי; f. יַתִּירָתָא, יְתֵי'. Targ. O. Num. III, 46.—B. Mets. 51 a בדמי י' at an extremely high price. Ruth R. to II, 14; Cant. R. to II, 9 אילין י' those forty five days more (Dan. XII, 11; 12). Ab. Zar. 9 b sq. ההוא שטרא … שית שנין י' a document which contained six years too many (was postdated by six years); a. fr.— Adv. יַתִּיר more. Targ. Ps. XIX, 11; a. e.—בְּיַתִּירְתָּא (= h. יותר מדאי) beyond measure. M. Kat. 27 b הות קא בכיא בי' (Ms. M. בתדירתא) she mourned unreasonably.
Gen. R. s. 10 שהן י' בעולם (better: יְתֵירִין, v. יָתֵר a. יָתַר).

verbetes.glosa_atual: [ser forte; denominação. יֶתֶר cordão, v. יִתְרָא I,] ser rico, abundante.; sobrar.; deixar sobrar; ir além; ser mais.; (denominação de יָתֵר) adicionar; fazer muito.
definicoes_originais: [ to be strong; denom. יֶתֶר cord, v. יִתְרָא I,] to be rich, plentiful.
to leave over; to go beyond; to be more.
(denom. of יָתֵר) to add; to do too much.
notas_originais: —Part. נוֹתָר m. portions of sacrifices left over beyond the legal time and bound to be burnt. Kerith. III, 4 והיה נ' מן וכ' and it was an overdue remnant of sacrifices. Ib. I, 1 דם נ' blood of overdue sacrifices. Meil. I, 3, a. fr. משום נ' as coming under the law of nothar; a. v. fr.— Pl. נוֹתָרִים, נוֹתָרוֹת. Sifré Aḥăré Par. 5, ch. VII.—Cant. R. to V, 14 כמה נ' how many laws about nothar. Num. R. s. 11 שלא לפסול … בנ' not to unfit any of the sacrifices by allowing them to become overdue.

Mekh. Bo s. 6 אם ה' if he left a part of the Passover lamb over until morning. Sifra Tsav, Par. 7, ch. XII אם ה' ה' if he has left over, he has left over (and it may be eaten). Ib. אם הוֹתִירוּ כולו if they left the whole of it over (for the second day); a. fr.—Ber. 34 b לא חסרתם ולא הוֹתַרְתֶּם you stated the time neither too early nor too late. B. Bath. VII, 2 ה' כל שהוא if it was somewhat more (than the stated measure).—b) הִתִּיר (cmp. הִצִּיק fr. יָצַק), v. infra.

Erub. 13 a שמא אתה … מְיַיתֵּר for if thou omit one letter or write one too many; Sot. 20 a תַּתִּיר Hif. (v. supra). Ex. R. s. 27; Tanḥ. Yithro 4 his name was Jether (Jethro) שֶׁיִּ' פרשה וכ' because he gave rise to an additional chapter (about judges) in the Law; Mekh. ib., Amalek, s. 1 שהוֹתִיר.—Ib. שיי' במעשים טובים because he did more (than ordinary men, was liberal in) good deeds. [Y. Keth. IV, end, 29 b וייתר, v. יָתַר.]— Part. pass. מְיוּתָּר, pl. מְיוּתָּרִין added, superfluous. Koh. R. to V, 8 (ref. to ויתרון, ib.) דברים שתראה (ש)הן מי' לתורה (not בתורה) things which thou wouldst regard as additions to the Law. Ib. אפי' דברים … מי' בעולם even things in nature which thou wouldst believe to be superfluous (useless); Ex. R. s. 10; (Gen. R. s. 10 יְתֵירָה); a. e.
Yoma 46 a איברי עולה שנִתּוֹתְרוּ parts of a burnt-offering which remained over (failed to be entirely burnt). Pes. 59 b כשנִיתּוֹתְרוּ when they were left over (unoffered).

notas_originais: Bekh. VII, 6 י' בידיו וכ' if one has an additional finger (or toe) on each of his hands and feet. Ib. 45 b.—Ib. 40 a חסר וי' ביד having one toe less or one too many on the forefoot. Ib. כל יתיר כנטול דמי every addition is considered equal to the entire absence of the respective limb; Ḥull. 58 b כל יתר וכ'. B. Bath. VII, 2, sq. הן י' (יתיר a. יתר interchanging), v. הֵן; a. fr.— Fem. יְתֵרָה, יְתֵירָה; (as noun also) יְתֶרֶת, יְתֶירֶת. Bekh. VII, 6 (45 a) היתה (בה) בו יתרת וכ' (Rashi יתירה; Gem. יתירת) if there has been an additional limb and he had it cut off. Ib. 40 a י' על של משה וכ' (a cubit measure) larger than the Mosaic by &c. Ḥull. III, 6 (as a sign of clean birds) כל שיש לו אצבע י' that which has an additional toe (on top of those in a line). Keth. 76 a יתירת a woman having an additional limb. Erub. 83 a י' על מדברית וכ' one sixth larger than &c.; a. fr. [V. יְתֵירָה.]— Pl. יְתֵרִים, יְתֵרִין, יְתֵי'; f. יְתֵירוֹת. Macc. 23 a יְתֵירֵי מדע men of more than ordinary knowledge; י' כח of more than common physical strength.—[Gen. R. s. 98 הניחו יתירות left remants of the conquered nations, prob. to be read: יְתֵידוֹת, v. יָתֵד.]—Esp. יְתֶרֶת an additional lobe of the lungs. Ḥull. 47 a (not יות').
— Pl. יְתֵירוֹת. Erub. 13 a, a. e., v. חָסֵר II.

notas_originais: It interchanges with ג q. v.; with ק, e.g. כּוֹבַע a. קוֹבַע; with ח, cmp. חבש a. כבש a. derivatives.

definicoes_originais: (b. h. כֹּה, v. preced.) adverb of place: here, v. הָכָא; of time: now.
notas_originais: Targ. Gen. XXII, 5. Targ. Job XXXVIII, 11; a. fr.—Y. Ber. IV, 7 c top וכא אמר הכין and here he says so? Ib. וכה; a. v. fr.—לְכָא hither; מִיכָּא from here. Targ. Josh. VIII, 20. definicoes_originais: (b. h.) to be heavy, to feel pain.
notas_originais: Y. Sabb. IX, 12 a ib. XIX, 17 a bot. (ref. to Gen. XXXIV, 25) בהיותו כּוֹאֵב כל איבריהם כּוֹאֲבִים עליהם … it does not say, ‘when it (the wound) was painful’, but …, which intimates that all their limbs pained them.

Ex. R. s. 3 (ref. to Ex. III, 7) ידעתי … להַכְאִיבֵנִי וכ' I know how much they will grieve me &c. Pirké d’R. El. ch. XII שלא להַכְאִיבוֹ so as to make him feel no pain. Midr. Till. to Ps. XCIV (ref. to Prov. III, 12) א"ת וּכְאָב אלא וּכְאֵב … שמַכְאִיבוֹ read not ukh’ab (and like a father) but ukh’eb (and pain), when He sends him pain.

Targ. Prov. XIV, 13.—Part. כָּאֵב, כָּאֵיב, כָּיֵב. Targ. Job XIV, 22. Targ. Ps. LXIX, 30; a. fr.—Targ. Jer. IV, 19 כֵּיבִין (ed. Lag. כָּיְיבָן).—B. Kam. 46 b מאן דכאיב ליה כאיבא וכ' Ms. F. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, Ms. H. כיבא) he who feels sick, goes to the physician. Ib. 85 b הוה כ' ליה מידי וסליק ואיתיב וכ' Ms. M. (ed. ואייתי) he had a sore and it was going away, and one put on a corrodent drug for him &c., v. חֲוַר. Gitt. 68 b כָּיֵיב; a. fr.—B. Kam. 35 a כיבין, v. חִינְכֵי.
Lam. R. to II, 1 translating יעיב, ib.) איך כ' וכ' how did the Lord wound &c., v. כֵּיבָא.
Ber. 55 a כ' לב heaviness of heart (fretfulness). Gen. R. s. 67, end כ' על כ' grief added to grief; a. e.
Deut. R. s. 3 (ref. to מכאביו, Ex. III, 7) יודע אני מה כ' וכ' I know what grievous offence they are going to commit, v. כָּאֵב.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) ser pesado, pesado, importante; cmp. יָקַר.; honrar, considerar precioso; para mostrar honra.; (cmp. אִיקְרָא, יְקַר) para oferecer um presente.; [para fazer parecer respeitável,] para varrer, ajustar o ambiente.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) to be heavy, weighty, important; cmp. יָקַר.
to honor, hold precious; to show honor.
(cmp. אִיקְרָא, יְקַר) to offer a gift.
[ to make look respectable,] to sweep, adjust the room.
to be honored; to pride, exalt one’s self.
to grow worse, be very sick (cmp. טָעַן II), opp. היקל.
notas_originais: Ab. IV, 1 איזהו מכובד המְכַבֵּד וכ' who will be honored? He who honors men. Sabb. 113 b ר"י קרי למאניה מְכַבְּדוֹתַי Rabbi Joh. called his garments ‘my honorers’; B. Kam. 91 b; Snh. 94 a; a. fr.—Ber. 46 b bot. אין מְכַבְּדִין וכ' we must not show honors (saying, ‘you go first’) on highroads &c. Part. pass. מְכוּבָּד, pl. מְכוּבָּדִים, מְכוּבָּדִין. Ab. l. c., v. supra. Ib. 6 כל המכבד … גופו מ' על וכ' he who honors the Law, will himself be honored of men. Ber. 60 b, v. infra. Ab. Zar. III, 3, v. בָּזָה; a. fr.
Tanḥ. Vayḥi 13 שמְכַבְּדִין מפירותיהם וכ' they offer of their fruits to kings; Gen. R. s. 99, end והם מבכרין (corr. acc.); a. e.

Ber. VIII, 4 מכבדיו את הבית וכ' (after meal) the room is put in order (the crumbs swept), and then &c. Bets. II, 7 (22 b) מכבדין בין המטות (Bab. ed. בית המטות) (on Holy Days) you may sweep between the dining couches (the dining room); Y. ib. II, 61 c bot. Tam. V, 5 היה מְכַבְּדָן לאמה one swept them (the coals) into the duct; a. fr.—Mikv. VIII, 4 כִּיבְּדָֹה את, הבית, v. בַּיִת 6.—[Ruth R. end וכבד some ed., read: וכָבַר.]

Gen. R. s. 1 כל המִתְכַּבֵּד בקלון וכ' whoever elevates himself at the expense of his neighbor’s degradation, has no share in the world to come; Y. Ḥag. II, 77 c. Meg. 28 a מימי לא נִתְכַּבַּדְתִּי וכ' I never elevated myself &c. Ber. 60 b הִתְכַּבְּדוּ מכובדים be in honor dismissed, you honored ones (angels); a. e.—2) to be cleaned, swept; to be dressed, adorned. Pes. 7 a שוקי … עשויין להתכ' וכ' the streets of Jerusalem used to be swept every day. Y. Nidd. I, beg. 48 d כמבוי שהוא מתכבד וכ' like an alley which is regularly swept and flushed. Bab. ib. 56 a חזקתז מתכבד it is presumed to be clean. Num. R. s. 13 לאכול ולשתות ולהתכבד to eat and drink and dress. [Tosef. Ter. X, 15 ליכבד, read with ed. Zuck. ליכבר, v. כָּבַר.]
Naz. I, 2 ה' שערו if his hair is too heavy on him.

Ex. R. s. 9; Tanḥ. Vaera 12 (play on כָּבֵד, Ex. VII, 14, a. הִכָּבְדִי XIV, 18) בלשון שהִכְבֵּדְתָּ בו בלשון אני מתכבד with the same expression (כבד) with which thou didst make heavy (Israel’s yoke), I shall be honored; Tanḥ. ed. Bub. ib. 14 שהכבדת את לבך wherewith thou didst harden thy heart.
Snh. IX, 1 ה' ומת grew worse and died; ib. 78 b; a. e.
Num. R. s. 23; Tanḥ. Masʿé 13 הִכְבִּידָן he swept (drove) them out, v. מַכְבֵּד a. הָמַם.

Ib. 56 b גומה לא מתכבדא a cavity is not swept (the broom does not strike it).

definicoes_originais: c. (b. h.; preced. wds.) [ heaviness, seat of anger and melancholy,] liver.
notas_originais: Ber. 61 b top כ' כועס ומרה וכ' the liver is excited, and the gall pours a drop over it and quiets it. Ḥull. III, 1 ניטל הכ'; ib. 2 ניטלה הכ' if the liver of an animal is gone. Arakh. V, 2 (20 a) ערך כְּבֵדִי עלי (Bab. ed. כְּבֵידִי) I vow the value of my liver (being a vital organ); a. fr.
Targ. Ex. XXIX, 13; 22. Targ. Lam. II, 11; a. e.—Ḥull. 109 b; a. fr.—Koh. R. to XII, 7; Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2) וחמי בכַבְדֵּיה, v. אִימַּר
, v. כבי
Arakh. 18 a ולידון בכְבוֹדוֹ (Ar. בכבידו) and that the value of a limb be judged according to its importance (vitality); ib. 4 b; B. Mets. 114 a

Ber. 19 b, a. e., v. חָלַק. Ib. משום כְּבוֹד מלכים on account of the respect due to royalty. Ib.; Men. 37 b גדול כְּ' הבריות וכ' human dignity (in proper appearance) is very important, for it may even suspend a Biblical law. Ber. l. c. ואינו לפי כְבוֹרוֹ and it is not becoming his dignity (to drive an ass). Sot. 13 a הניחו לו כְּבוֹדוֹ במלכים יותר וכ' let him alone, the honor shown to him (Jacob) by princes is higher than that by private men. Ib. נהגו בהן כ' they treated them with respect. Ned. 39 b בכְבוֹדִי לא מחיתם בכְ' וכ' as long as My honor was concerned, you did not interfere, and when the honor of a human being is at stake &c. Ab. IV, 12 יהי כְ' תלמידך וכ' let the honor of thy pupil be as dear to thee as thine own, and thy fellow student’s honor as that of thy teacher; a. v. fr.—כסא הכ', v. כִּסֵּא. מחל על כבודו to forego due honors, v. מָחַל.
